Chinese buyers began stockpiling chips, Trump backed his return as 177,000 signed a petition, and Nvidia doubled profit to $65.3 billion without him.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: Houthi strikes hit Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and an Aramco skyscraper in Riyadh, yet Brent fell below $90, and Saudi Arabia then reported October output up 26%. Brent jumped to $94.30 after Trump's Iran post, and Iraq's Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline pumped crude again after a decade.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.
poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.recent: The fortnight's reporting carried the U.S. midterm election and Trump Jr.'s exit from Kalshi after his firm's investment in Polymarket, but nothing on Hegseth himself, and none of it accounts for the swing in this contract.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent of United Airlines, one of the three largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move on jet fuel costs, business-travel demand and its transatlantic and Pacific routes.
stocks:UAL.recent: United stopped AI agents such as OpenAI's dots from booking its flights over security concerns. Five days later a widespread system outage stalled its departures for 90 minutes, part of a run of failures at Microsoft, the FAA, Chase and Apple Pay that ended with the White House firing Cairncross.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company Elon Musk founded. It flies most of the world's orbital launches and runs Starlink, the largest satellite internet network, and its military Starshield variant makes it a defence contractor too.
stocks:SPCX.recent: The tower caught Ship 42, a Starship upper stage, after 14 orbits, a first. SpaceX also laid out $74 billion in AI computing campuses, and the European Commission demanded Starshield be restored in Ukraine, where Zelensky says it cuts off drones above 161 km/h. None of it is tied to the share price.

wiki-jensen-huang.standing: Co-founder of Nvidia, the chipmaker whose graphics processors became the hardware most AI models are trained on. He led it from its founding in 1993, and its rise made him one of the most closely watched executives in technology.
wiki-jensen-huang.recent: Nvidia investigated Jensen Huang over an affair with a Singapore-based company's CEO, tied to a US-China spy scandal; after Sen. Cramer called on him to resign, he quit and Colette Kress, finance chief since 2013, became interim CEO. Trump has since backed his return, and 177,000 people signed a petition to reinstate him.

poly-us-strike-on-cuba-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States carries out a military strike on Cuba before its deadline. Its price is what traders stake on open conflict between Washington and Havana, 90 miles apart across the Florida Straits.

stocks:BABA.standing: The Hangzhou group behind Taobao and Tmall, China's biggest online marketplaces, and the country's largest cloud computing business. These New York-listed shares trade on Chinese consumer spending and its bets on artificial intelligence.
stocks:BABA.recent: The fortnight's news about Alibaba was all expansion. Apple's iPhone AI in China launched running on Qwen, Alibaba sold nearly 100,000 AI monthly passes at one fen each, and it said it would keep control of its T-Head chip unit after a Hong Kong listing. None of it accounts for the fall in the share.

poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors visit an Iranian nuclear site by the year's end. Those inspections are the only outside check on how much enriched uranium Iran holds.
poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.recent: Iran's Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty, Mehr reported, and a day later the UN watchdog called on Iran to reopen facilities it has been unable to inspect since the US-Israeli attacks. Washington, meanwhile, offered up to $20 million to informants on Iran's nuclear program.

stocks:1024.HK.standing: Kuaishou runs China's second-largest short-video and live-streaming app after ByteDance's Douyin, and earns from advertising, live-stream tipping and e-commerce. Its shares follow Chinese ad spending and its contest with Douyin.
stocks:1024.HK.recent: Kuaishou is doubling down on Kling, its AI video model, which earned over $20 million in December 2025 alone, while Chinese giants such as Alibaba list AI units in Hong Kong. Neither story explains the fall in the share.

poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a peace deal before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it moves on talks, battlefield turns and Washington's diplomacy.
poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.recent: Russia and Ukraine held their first peace talks in 9 months, and Putin was not ready to make peace in Abu Dhabi; Zelensky said the US had suggested Kyiv cede land for Nato entry. Then the strikes escalated: Russia hit Kyiv's bridges and subway, Ukrainian drones hit the Crimean Bridge, and Putin vowed 'much more painful' strikes.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an effective ceasefire before its deadline. Its price is what traders will pay to bet on a truce, not a forecast of one.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.recent: Bets on a truce peaked after Iran, in talks in Islamabad, shortened its Strait of Hormuz reopening plan from 7 days to 2. They fell away once the US bombed Qeshm Island and Tehran answered with fire on an airbase in Kuwait and repeated attacks on Bahrain, as Iran said mines had hit 4 tankers in 24 hours and a third US carrier reached the Gulf.

poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the first lawmaker Israel's president asks to form a government after the 2026 vote succeeds, so that no second candidate is handed the mandate. Each failed round brings Israel closer to another election.
poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.recent: Israel's coalition talks are running against a deadline, with a former prime minister playing kingmaker and Eisenkot negotiating a unity government with Netanyahu, the man he says must go. The opposition called the election-day arrest of 3 Arab-party members on unfounded information a coup.

stocks:AMZN.standing: The world's largest online retailer and, through Amazon Web Services, the biggest seller of cloud computing. AWS earns most of the company's operating profit, so the share moves on cloud demand as much as on shopping.
stocks:AMZN.recent: United Launch Alliance's Vulcan failed minutes after launch and destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites, a loss ULA blamed on its fuel supply rather than Blue Origin's engines. A study in Berlin found that Meta and Amazon paid under 9% tax in 2025. Neither accounts for the share's path.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's largest lender, listed in Frankfurt and run with a large investment-banking arm. The price tracks European interest rates, trading income and the bank's legal and credit costs.
stocks:DBK.DE.recent: The shares dropped when reports surfaced of a leak of 15 million internal files. They show the bank kept about 28,000 clients its own compliance staff had flagged, and that a May 2020 memo tied two Trump companies to laundromats. Later files showed staff excusing Brazilian clients, Vale and Braskem among them.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by year's end. Funding rounds and share sales set that valuation, so the price moves on news of either.

stocks:JPM.standing: America's largest bank by assets, joining the Chase consumer bank to one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its shares are read as a gauge of US credit, consumer spending and dealmaking.
stocks:JPM.recent: Chase's systems failed for the third time in a week on Monday, when nearly 5,000 customers reported outages to Downdetector and Zelle payments stalled. Three days later hackers took customer data from JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard through a vendor the three payment giants share.

poly-will-jensen-huang-rejoin-nvidia-by-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jensen Huang, who co-founded NVIDIA and ran it as chief executive for three decades, returns to the company before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders pay for a yes.

stocks:AVIO.MI.standing: Avio builds Europe's Vega small-satellite rockets and the solid-fuel boosters that lift Ariane 6, from its works at Colleferro near Rome. It is the continent's main alternative to buying launches from SpaceX.
stocks:AVIO.MI.recent: Early in the month Avio scaled back a demonstrator programme over technical challenges. Then ICEYE bid €41 a share, a 21.3% premium and €2.05 billion in all, and pledged €1 billion more of investment in Italy. The Finnish radar-satellite operator wants its own launcher, and the Italian state, which holds a stake in Avio, has a golden-power veto over the sale.

wiki-artificial-intelligence.standing: The English Wikipedia article on artificial intelligence: software that learns from data to reason, write, see and act. How many open it each day shows how far the subject reaches beyond the people building it.
wiki-artificial-intelligence.recent: Washington licensed Nvidia and AMD chips to military-listed Chinese firms four days after closing a remote-access loophole on AI chips, while Nvidia itself was shaken by Jensen Huang's confession email to staff. In San Francisco, ten countries signed an AI supply-chain pact, and China is not among them.

poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States lifts its naval blockade of Iran by 30 November 2026. The blockade sets how much Iranian oil reaches buyers and how freely tankers move through the Gulf.
poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.recent: At talks in Islamabad, Iran shortened its plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz from 7 days to 2. The same week, Iran said mines hit 4 tankers in 24 hours and a third US carrier reached the Gulf. After the US bombed Qeshm Island, Iran struck Kuwait and Bahrain, and peace talks stalled.

stocks:UBER.standing: The largest ride-hailing and food-delivery platform outside China, taking a cut of each fare its drivers and couriers carry. Its margins rest on how regulators let it classify and pay those workers.
stocks:UBER.recent: The news about Uber's own business in the window was its exit from Nigeria and a third-party breach it said touched nearly 150,000 people. The breach was disclosed after the latest close, and neither story accounts for the price.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of Apple, the Cupertino maker of the iPhone, the Mac and a large paid-services business, and one of the most valuable companies listed on the Nasdaq. The iPhone still brings in about half of its revenue.
stocks:AAPL.recent: Apple's iPhone AI launched in China running on Alibaba's Qwen, and Thai officials met Apple over spyware alerts sent to politicians. Days later its apps went down in a wave of US outages, which Apple said an internal update caused. Nothing reported ties any of it to the share price.

stocks:CVX.standing: One of the two largest US oil companies, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Kazakhstan and Australia's LNG plants and refining it into fuel. Its share price tracks oil prices and its spending on new supply.

stocks:XOM.standing: The largest US oil and gas company, pumping crude and natural gas worldwide and refining it into fuels and chemicals. Its shares move with the oil price and with refining margins.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest energy company, producing oil and gas worldwide and ranking among the biggest traders of liquefied natural gas, with a growing power and renewables arm. This series is its New York listing, priced in dollars.
stocks:TTE.recent: West Coast fishers at Port Nolloth are challenging TotalEnergies' offshore drilling, and a High Court judgment on the case is due soon. A pending ruling on one licence does not account for the slide in the share.

poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Édouard Philippe, Emmanuel Macron's prime minister from 2020 to 2022 and founder of the Horizons party, wins France's 2027 presidential election, the first Macron cannot contest.

stocks:VALE.standing: Brazil's largest miner and one of the world's biggest iron ore producers, also mining nickel and copper. Its shares trade in New York and follow Chinese steel demand, the main buyer of its ore.

stocks:BRKM5.SA.standing: Brazil's largest petrochemical company and the biggest maker of thermoplastic resins in the Americas, controlled jointly by Novonor and Petrobras. Its profits ride the spread between naphtha feedstock and plastic resin prices.

poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Houthi forces enter Aden, the southern port where Yemen's internationally recognised government sits, by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders bet on the war's front reaching the south.
poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.recent: Government forces withdrew from an area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and left the Houthis in control, and the Houthis freed 600 fighters as Yemen's forces were redeployed. Taiz then saw fierce battles, and the Saudi coalition answered with strikes on 60 Houthi military sites and on Hodeidah.

stocks:TTWO.standing: The New York video game publisher that owns Rockstar Games and 2K, behind Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption and NBA 2K, plus Zynga's mobile titles. Its share price turns on the timing and sales of a few blockbuster releases.
stocks:TTWO.recent: Grand Theft Auto VI, Rockstar's first new entry in the series after a 13-year wait, launched to rave reviews and has sold 17 million copies. The publisher's earnings outlook has been built around this release. Before launch, Rockstar fired 31 unionising UK staff, and that dispute followed the game to market.

stocks:JD.standing: A Beijing-based online retailer that, unlike marketplace rivals, owns much of the stock it sells and runs its own warehouse and delivery network. Its Nasdaq-listed shares trade as a gauge of Chinese household spending.
stocks:JD.recent: JD.com reported a 5.2 billion yuan quarterly operating profit, a return to profit, on 2026-11-19. That came a day after the last reading on the chart, so it does not explain the slide. Nothing about the company's own business in the fortnight before accounts for the fall.

poly-will-josh-shapiro-win-the-2028-demo.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Josh Shapiro, Pennsylvania's Democratic governor, wins his party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in a field with no declared frontrunner.

stocks:PANW.standing: One of the largest cybersecurity companies, selling firewalls and network and cloud security software to businesses and governments. Its shares are a read on how much companies spend defending their systems against attack.
stocks:PANW.recent: Palo Alto bought Applied Compute for $4.5bn on the view that open-weight AI models, which went from under 5% to over 60% of token usage in a year, leave enterprises securing models they host themselves. Nikesh Arora put that market in the hundreds of billions, and Stifel reiterated Buy after a strong Q1.

poly-trump-meets-with-kim-jong-un-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Donald Trump and North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un meet in person before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.
poly-trump-meets-with-kim-jong-un-by-dec.recent: Trump's Asia swing took him to Manila for the Quad, then to Shenzhen, where he met Putin and Xi and signed a three-power declaration that names no war. Kim Jong Un was not part of it. Meanwhile the IAEA said North Korea is expanding enrichment at Yongbyon, as Washington drops denuclearisation from its priorities and cuts back drills with Seoul.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate by a quarter point at its January 2027 meeting. That rate sets the cost of dollar borrowing for governments, firms and households worldwide.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: October's consumer prices beat forecasts, and Logan called for two more rate hikes, possibly rapidly, as two-year Treasury yields jumped overnight. Deutsche Bank and J.P. Morgan then forecast hikes at consecutive meetings, and minutes of the October meeting showed almost all officials expect more rate hikes.

stocks:SONY.standing: US-listed shares of Sony Group, the Tokyo conglomerate behind PlayStation, Sony Music and Sony Pictures, and the biggest maker of smartphone camera sensors. Games and music now earn it more than electronics do.

stocks:LMT.standing: The largest US defence contractor, maker of the F-35 fighter, missile systems and NASA's Orion crew capsule. Most of its revenue comes from the US government, so its shares move on Pentagon budgets and large contract awards.
stocks:LMT.recent: What the news did carry on the company came after its October swings: the rocket venture Lockheed Martin shares with Boeing failed minutes after launch, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites, and the Artemis change left Orion to be pushed by Starship at up to 1 g. Neither accounts for the share price.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: What traders pay for a contract that settles yes if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei. The capital has not elected a DPP mayor since Chen Shui-bian won in 1994.

poly-will-ron-desantis-win-the-2028-us-p.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Ron DeSantis, the Florida Republican who ran for the 2024 nomination and quit early, wins the White House in 2028. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome.
poly-will-ron-desantis-win-the-2028-us-p.recent: The fortnight's news carried the fallout from a US election, with Trump making Hegseth pay for the debacle and a Mississippi Black vote producing its biggest shock, but none of it names DeSantis or accounts for the bet.

stocks:OHB.DE.standing: A Bremen-based space company listed in Frankfurt, and Europe's third satellite builder after Airbus and Thales. It builds the Galileo navigation satellites, so its fortunes ride on European Space Agency and EU budgets.
stocks:OHB.DE.recent: The one story about OHB's own business came at the end of the slide: the European Space Agency ordered a €102m satellite catcher, ClearSpace-1, with the work centred on Bremen. The order arrived after the fall, and nothing in the input explains the drop from late October.

poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Vladimir Putin stops being Russia's president before March 2027, whether by death, resignation or removal. He has led Russia as president or prime minister since 1999.
poly-putin-out-as-president-of-russia-by.recent: Putin spent the fortnight at the table, not under threat: Russia and Ukraine held their first peace talks in 9 months, he joined Trump and Xi at the Shenzhen summit, and he vowed 'much more painful' strikes on Ukraine. Nothing in it touched his grip on power at home.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the Florida Republican, wins his party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, set against contracts on his rivals.

poly-will-crude-oil-reach-a-new-all-time.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if crude oil sets a new record price before the year ends. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it reflects bets on supply shocks, war and OPEC output.
poly-will-crude-oil-reach-a-new-all-time.recent: The fortnight's news offered nothing on oil supply or demand. It carried Trump Jr. leaving Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into Polymarket, and traders' bets on a December Fed hike, and neither accounts for the repricing of this contract.

poly-iran-full-airspace-closure-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Iran shuts its entire airspace to civilian flights before the end of November 2026. Iranian skies carry long-haul routes between Europe, the Gulf and South Asia, so a full closure forces airlines onto longer detours.
poly-iran-full-airspace-closure-by-novem.recent: Bettors pulled back even as the war widened. After the US bombed Qeshm Island, Iran struck an airbase in Kuwait and hit Bahrain repeatedly, and Iran's Guard said mines struck tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. None of that shut Iran's skies, and in Islamabad, Tehran cut its Hormuz reopening plan from 7 days to 2.

wiki-federal-reserve.standing: The central bank of the United States, which sets the short-term interest rate for dollar lending and supervises the country's largest banks. Its decisions move borrowing costs, currencies and asset prices worldwide.
wiki-federal-reserve.recent: October consumer prices rose 0.4%, beating forecasts, and the Fed's Logan called for two more rate hikes. Two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points on fears of a 50 bps move. Minutes then showed almost all officials expect more hikes, and Goolsbee left a larger-than-usual rise open for December.

wiki-gold.standing: Daily reads of Wikipedia's article on gold, the metal central banks hold as reserves and households buy as a store of value. Its price tends to fall when US interest rates and the dollar rise.
wiki-gold.recent: Gold lost 8.9% this week, its worst since March, as Fed signals of more rate hikes and a firm dollar pushed spot prices to $3,757 an ounce, the lowest since September 2025. The slide, 31.5% since January, drained a savings cushion for Turkish households, while Swissaid found the UAE still the top destination for smuggled African gold.

stocks:V.standing: Visa runs the world's largest card payment network and earns a small fee on each transaction under its brand. It lends no money itself, so its revenue tracks consumer spending and cross-border travel.
stocks:V.recent: Hackers took customer data from Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Chase through one shared third-party vendor, days after JPMorgan's own outage. Because three pillars of the payment system rely on the same contractor, one breach reached all three. The companies say nothing sensitive was taken.

stocks:MA.standing: One of the two global card networks, alongside Visa. It does not lend; it takes a small fee on each payment routed over its rails, so its shares track consumer spending and cross-border travel.
stocks:MA.recent: Hackers took customer data from Mastercard, Visa and JPMorgan Chase through a third-party vendor all three share, so one contractor's breach reached three pillars of the payment system at once. The companies said nothing sensitive was taken. Nothing else in the news accounts for the earlier swings.

poly-will-the-south-african-reserve-bank.standing: What traders on Polymarket pay for the South African Reserve Bank raising its repo rate, the rate it lends to banks at, by a quarter point in January. South African prime lending rates on mortgages and car loans move with it.
poly-will-the-south-african-reserve-bank.recent: The fortnight's news was about the Fed, not the SARB: hot US October inflation, minutes showing almost all Fed officials expect more hikes, and Goolsbee leaving a larger December rise open. None of it concerns the SARB or explains the swings in this contract.

stocks:AMD.standing: A Santa Clara chip designer that makes processors and graphics chips for PCs, game consoles and data centres, and the main challenger to Nvidia in the accelerators used to train and run AI models.
stocks:AMD.recent: The Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security licensed hundreds of thousands of advanced AMD and Nvidia GPUs to firms the Department of War lists as Chinese military companies, though few chips shipped as Chinese clouds moved to domestic silicon. That broke after the latest close, and nothing reported before it accounts for the fall.

poly-will-google-have-the-best-ai-model-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if a Google model holds the top spot on a public AI leaderboard at the end of 2026. It is a running bet on which lab leads the frontier, a race that shapes where cloud customers and developers spend.

poly-will-apple-be-the-largest-company-i.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Apple is the world's most valuable listed company at year's end. Its price tracks the race against the other trillion-dollar giants, which is mostly a race over chips and AI spending.

poly-variational-fdv-above-1b-one-day-af.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Variational's token is valued above $1 billion fully diluted (its price times its total eventual supply) the day after it starts trading. It is a bet on how a new crypto token prices at launch.

stocks:LHA.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's flag carrier, parent of Swiss, Austrian and Brussels Airlines, traded in Frankfurt. Jet fuel and pay for pilots and cabin crew are its largest costs, so oil prices and strikes move the stock.
stocks:LHA.DE.recent: Lufthansa said it will cut 1,000 full-time jobs at its loss-making mainline airline at the Munich and Frankfurt hubs, after the flagship lost €180 million in nine months, and named high jet fuel costs as the pressure. The announcement came after the shares' climb and does not explain it.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance, the sitting US vice-president, wins the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it tracks his standing as heir to the Republican ticket.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.recent: The fortnight's news carried Trump making Defense Secretary Hegseth pay for an election debacle and a Mississippi Black vote that produced the election's biggest shock, but nothing about Vance himself or a 2028 run that accounts for the price.

poly-will-kamala-harris-win-the-2028-dem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Kamala Harris, the former vice president and 2024 nominee, wins the Democrats' 2028 nomination. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.
poly-will-kamala-harris-win-the-2028-dem.recent: What the fortnight carried on prediction markets was about the venues, not this race: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm invested $300 million in Polymarket. None of it touches the Democratic contest or accounts for the price.

poly-nato-x-russia-military-clash-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if NATO forces and Russia's military clash directly before the end of 2026. It prices the risk that the war in Ukraine spills onto alliance territory and draws its members in.
poly-nato-x-russia-military-clash-by-dec.recent: The bets fell as Russia and Ukraine held their first peace talks in 9 months, Putin met Trump and Xi at the Shenzhen summit, and the US called for a new Europe security framework. A suspected Russian missile burning in a field in Lublin province, inside Poland, did not reverse it: debris on NATO soil is not a clash between forces.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: The Wikipedia article on bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency: a digital currency capped at 21 million coins and recorded on a public ledger that no bank or government controls.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: Bitcoin fell from about $74,000 to briefly below $62,000 in November as bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike pulled money out. Spot ETFs lost a net $1.282 billion in one week, and BlackRock's fund posted a record $541 million outflow. MSCI also dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes.

poly-will-dominique-de-villepin-be-on-th.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Dominique de Villepin, Jacques Chirac's former prime minister, makes the first-round ballot of France's 2027 presidential election. Getting on it takes 500 sponsorships from elected officials.

stocks:BLK.standing: The world's largest asset manager, behind the iShares exchange-traded funds. It earns fees on the money it manages, so its shares rise and fall with the markets that money sits in and with flows into its products.
stocks:BLK.recent: BlackRock's own bitcoin fund posted a record $541 million outflow as the selloff that took bitcoin below $65,000 for the first time since August persisted. That outflow came after the last close shown, and nothing else here explains the share's path over the window.

poly-ai-industry-downturn-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if an AI bubble bursts before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on a collapse in the valuations of AI firms, a trade much of the stock market now leans on.

poly-will-nicols-maduro-be-the-leader-of.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Nicolás Maduro is still Venezuela's leader at the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on sanctions, opposition talks and pressure from Washington.

poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran's top leadership changes hands before the year ends. Power in the Islamic Republic runs through the Supreme Leader, so the price is a bet on the system's apex, not on an election.
poly-iran-leadership-change-by-december-.recent: The bets eased as Iran kept fighting: it struck Kuwait and Bahrain after a US strike on Qeshm, its Guard said mines hit tankers in Hormuz, and through Islamabad it shortened its Hormuz reopening plan. None of it pointed to a change at the top in Tehran, and nothing in the fortnight's news accounts for the price.

stocks:005930.KS.standing: South Korea's largest company and one of the world's biggest makers of memory chips, alongside phones and displays. It is the heaviest weight in the Kospi, so its share moves with the global chip cycle and drags the market with it.
stocks:005930.KS.recent: A selloff in AI stocks hit the memory makers hardest, and Samsung and SK Hynix led the Kospi to a fall of more than 5%. Separately, Samsung was reported in buyout talks with Modine, whose own shares jumped the most in six years on the news.

stocks:7974.T.standing: The Kyoto maker of the Switch consoles and the Mario and Zelda franchises, listed in Tokyo. Most of its sales are abroad, so the share moves on hardware sell-through, its game release slate and the yen.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: One of the world's two largest makers of memory chips, based in South Korea and part of the SK Group. Its high-bandwidth memory sits beside the processors in AI data centres, so its shares trade as a bet on AI spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: SK Hynix is working around the clock to finish its first fab in Yongin, a plant that will stand 150 metres tall. A day after this reading, an AI selloff took the Kospi down more than 5%, with SK Hynix and Samsung leading the fall. Neither story accounts for the earlier slide.

poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-democr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jon Ossoff, the Democratic senator from Georgia, becomes his party's presidential nominee in 2028. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.
poly-will-jon-ossoff-win-the-2028-democr.recent: The fortnight's news about prediction markets was about the industry, not the race: Trump Jr. left his advisory role at Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into its rival Polymarket. Nothing in it explains the bets on Ossoff.
